executionRulings: Ruling: continue in the existing authorized inline workflow and branch without another approval menu — user selected the next optimization at our judgment and prior quality constraints remain — cost if wrong: bounded diagnostic time; product still requires measured exact parity and a concrete implementation extension.

Ruling: investigate atmosphere output with a separate cloned color-only target — it is the last remaining fullscreen MSAA destination before the already optimizedHDR; allocated-target sample/depth mutation and generic resolve suppression can invalidate depth or alter geometry — cost if wrong: candidate costs8bytes/pixel additional storage and may be rejected.

Ruling: preserve natural LODs in new planet views and compare resolve counts per matched view — baseline6->candidate5 is established for belt views,not every future viewpoint — cost if wrong: some viewpoints may have different totalcounts; require exactlyone removed atmosphere resolve in all accepted comparisons.

Ruling: record the two exact pre-existing compiler warnings separately and require their occurrence during untouched baseline planet warmup — captured program logs and GLSL identify existing planet shaders,not the atmosphere destination change — cost if wrong: an existing derivative/shader issue remains outside this optimization; any new warning or candidate-phase warning still fails the gate.

Ruling: require zero in-flight cloud requests and two seconds of network quiet before measurements,then another16frames and recheck — a fixed96-frame warmup left W26 terrain textures loading — cost if wrong: extra diagnostic time; without this gate image comparisons could use incomplete assets.

Ruling: accept one extra atmosphere RGBA16F target and reuse the terminal output lifecycle in a fixed three-pass chain — exact14case image controls and12ordered pass pairs support0.86..1.39ms savings — cost if wrong:7.03MiB720p/63.28MiB4K additional format storage; no claim that all tail percentiles improve or that whole-frame3.30ms is attributable solely to this pass.
